key_impacts: ~15 million cubic meters of debris swept onto coastal settlements
evidence_snippets: December 1999 debris flows hit Venezuela’s Caribbean coastal strip, killing ~30,000 and causing about $2 billion damage.
Two years’ worth of rain fell in two days, dislodging saturated soils.
Deadly landslides in Venezuela in December 1999 capped the decade.
